content.text:
Set up a Maven Spring Boot REST API project (`com.example:demo`, Spring Boot 4.1.1, Java 21):

- `pom.xml` — `spring-boot-starter-webmvc` + test starter, `spring-boot-maven-plugin`
- `DemoApplication.java` — main entry point
- `HelloController.java` — `GET /api/hello?name=X` REST endpoint
- `DemoApplicationTests.java` — Spring context test

Verified: `mvn package` builds clean, `mvn test` passes, and the built jar runs with `GET /api/hello` returning `200 Hello, World!` (and `Hello, Aman!` with a query param).

Note: Spring Initializr's metadata reported the parent version as `4.1.1.RELEASE`, which doesn't exist on Maven Central (Spring Boot dropped the `.RELEASE` suffix after 2.x) — I corrected it to `4.1.1` after checking Maven Central directly.
